a = list(map(int, input().split()))
t = int(input())

a.sort()

maxCount = 0
for i in range(n):
    upperBound = a[i] + t
    j = i
    while j < n and a[j] <= upperBound:
        j += 1
    count = j - i
    if count > maxCount:
        maxCount = count
